prompt: Show monthly revenue split by promo flag for 2023 as a grouped bar chart. The grouped bar chart should show, for each month, 2 bars representing promo and non-promo sales

data.sql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', s.Sold_Date) AS month_start,
    s.On_Promo AS on_promo_flag,
    SUM(s.Total_Sale_Value) AS revenue_usd
  FROM sales s
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.Sold_Date) = 2023
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT
  m.month_start,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN m.on_promo_flag = 1 THEN m.revenue_usd END), 0) AS revenue_on_promo_usd,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN m.on_promo_flag = 0 THEN m.revenue_usd END), 0) AS revenue_non_promo_usd
FROM monthly m
GROUP BY m.month_start
ORDER BY m.month_start;

chart_config.title: Monthly Revenue Split by Promo Flag (2023)

data.chart_code:
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))

x = data_df["month_start"]
y_columns = ["revenue_on_promo_usd", "revenue_non_promo_usd"]

bar_width = 0.38
x_positions = range(len(x))

for i, col in enumerate(y_columns):
    offset = (i - (len(y_columns) - 1) / 2) * bar_width
    plt.bar([p + offset for p in x_positions], data_df[col].values, width=bar_width, label=col)

plt.xlabel("month_start")
plt.ylabel("Revenue (USD)")
plt.title("Monthly Revenue Split by Promo Flag (2023)")

plt.xticks(list(x_positions), [str(v) for v in x], rotation=45, ha="right")
plt.grid(True, axis="y", alpha=0.3)
plt.legend()

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
